coherence_findings.issue: All ten open with the same sentence shape: 'This isn't metaphor—it's structural identity' (or 'physics', 'mathematical transformation', 'process constraint'). It is earned on the audio half of several (Fourier, FM sidebands, t = d/c) and not on the life half of any: muscles and friendships under stress, trust as a threshold, parenting as sidechain. The hub's closing line says 'That's not poetry. That's physics.' This is the exact over-claim Philosopher Visits the Entry was written to push on (its Method step 1 quotes 'This is not metaphor but isomorphism'; the oscillator visit replaced it with a smaller, more durable claim). The hub's own open question ('How do we prevent false pattern matching?') sits unanswered one page away from the page that answers it.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Per page, one sentence saying which half is literal and which is a shared shape ('the audio half is physics; the relationship half is the same shape, and it is the shape that transfers'). Smaller is more durable. Then send one Philosopher Visit to the hub (the load-bearing claim is 'not metaphor, structural identity'). This is taste as much as honesty, so it is Loudon's call; the verified part is only that the claim is stated ten times at one strength.

coherence_findings.issue: Two things stated as fact that I can check against the page's own formula. (1) 'A wall 10 meters away returns its reflection 29 milliseconds late' and 'a 5-meter wall returns its reflection in 14.6ms': t = d/343 is right only if d is the path travelled, and a reflection off a wall 10 m away (source and listener together) travels 20 m, about 58 ms. 29 ms is the one-way figure. (2) 'Time and space convert into each other through the speed of sound, exactly as they convert through the speed of light.' A fixed conversion rate is true in both cases, but only light's speed is the same for every observer, which is what makes spacetime one fabric; the speed of sound is not. 'Exactly' overreaches, and 'This isn't metaphor—it's physics. Reverb is space-time made audible' carries the same overreach.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Change to 'a wall 10 m away returns its echo about 58 ms later (a 20 m round trip)' and '5 m wall, about 29 ms'. Soften the relativity sentence to: delay and distance trade at a fixed rate, the speed of sound; special relativity trades time and distance at the speed of light, which is the same for every observer. I derived this from the page's formula and standard acoustics; I did not look it up.

coherence_findings.issue: Technical Side: 'a carrier sine wave at 400Hz, modulated in frequency by another sine at 200Hz ... at depth 1 it sounds like brass; at depth 5 like a bell.' With carrier:modulator = 2:1 every sideband (400 ± n·200) falls on a multiple of 200 Hz, so the spectrum stays harmonic: organ or brass-like at any depth, not a bell. Bells need inharmonic ratios (the page says so itself under 'FM sounds organic': 'Bells: Metal resonance creates inharmonic partials'). The page's own line 'FM modulation gives you 200Hz, 400Hz, 600Hz...' is the harmonic case.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Keep the 400/200 pair for the harmonic demonstration and say a bell needs a ratio like 1:1.4 (inharmonic). Reasoned from the sideband formula in the page; not re-run on a synth.

coherence_findings.issue: Advanced Applications: the spectrogram 'enables time-stretching without pitch shift — impossible in either single-domain view.' Time-domain methods (WSOLA, PSOLA, granular playback) stretch time without shifting pitch, so 'impossible' is wrong; the true claim is that the phase vocoder does it cleanly on sustained and polyphonic material.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Replace 'impossible in either single-domain view' with 'hard to do cleanly from either single view alone'.

coherence_findings.issue: The page maps compression onto relationship in two directions that disagree. Teaching and table: more compression = more closeness ('Amount of compression = amount of intimacy you want listener to feel'; 4:1 is 'right here', uncompressed is 'over there'). The Vulnerability Parallel: 'Ratio = Degree of authenticity. 1:1 ratio: No compression (fully authentic). ∞:1 ratio: Limiter (complete guard up)' and 'Threshold = Trust level ... Above threshold: Compression kicks in (defenses activate)'. In the first, higher ratio is closer; in the second, higher ratio is more guarded. The Over-Compression section tries to reconcile them, but the parameter map still reads backward against Part 3.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Pick one mapping. The structural one (shrinking the range between loud and quiet = closeness) is the page's strength and its hook. Either delete 'The Vulnerability Parallel' parameter list, or flip it so it describes the person narrowing their own range. Loudon's call; it is his central teaching bridge.
coherence_findings.confidence: high that they conflict, none on which to keep

coherence_findings.issue: Quotations I could not verify. Compression: 'Rick Rubin (The Creative Act): "Compression brings listener and artist closer together."' reads as a paraphrase, and the claim that Cash's American Recordings vocals are 'heavily compressed' is unsourced. Hub: 'Douglas Hofstadter (Gödel, Escher, Bach): "Analogy is the core of cognition."' coherence_findings.proposed_action: Mark as paraphrase or give a page and edition. Re-attribute the Hofstadter line to Surfaces and Essences, or drop the quotation marks.

summary: Fourteen pages, all genuine nested canon: ten catalogue sub-entries of the Cross-Domain Resonances hub and four named modes under Modes of Collaboration, none of them substrate (Excellent Adventure is even older than its parent). The bundle-hygiene linter will keep warning on them; a rule of 'member-of the parent plus two inbound from outside the bundle' would let it stop. The Cross-Domain family is sound and well taught but carries faults that only reading it whole shows: one over-claim stated ten times ('this isn't metaphor, it's structure'), which is exactly what Philosopher Visits the Entry exists to push on; four factual slips I can check from the pages' own formulas (Reverb's 29 ms should be about 58 ms, Synthesis's 400/200 Hz FM cannot sound like a bell, Frequency Domain's 'impossible', Compression's two opposite ratio-to-intimacy maps); two unverified quotations; a stray Chinese word in Saturation; and a false cross-bridge pair (Compression and Frequency Domain each point at Kick Drum for something it does not hold), which I replaced with a real one (Compression and Reverb are the two distance cues).
